Intel Registration Confirmation
INTEL® ON DEMAND WEB SERVICES
Access granted, Welcome to the Intel® On Demand VLS web services staging environment!
Dear {!Contact.Name},
This notice is to inform you that you have been granted access to Intel® On Demand VLS web services staging environment (VLS-TEST).Use your login credentials listed below to log into the Intel® On Demand API Portal.
E-mail Address: {!Contact.Email}
Retain this email for future reference. Your use of Intel’s websites are governed by Intel’s Terms of Use linked from the bottom of each respective site’s web pages. If you have questions, did not request this update, or feel you have received this email in error, please contact us. To manage your profile, including available marketing subscriptions, please visit My Intel.
Sincerely,
Registration Administrator
Intel® On Demand Team
Please DO NOT reply to this e-mail message. This is an automated response. To ensure that you continue receiving our e-mails, please add us to your address book.
